author: 911pvp
body:
A few tournament teams have been created and the tournament is coming up, so why not add a "Team" tab on profiles? It would be easier to keep track of who is on your team and for other players to see who is on a certain team. This feature should be added, and it shouldn't be too hard.
 Thanks, 
      lord_brukr
